relevance.rationale: Join CONFIRMED 2026-09-07 against the title page: arXiv:1404.2541v1, single author, 22 pp, matches the morita2014 entry (library block docId arxiv-1404.2541v1). HISTORY, kept because the row read the opposite for a month: the 2026-08-08 assessment recorded 'WRONG JOIN - LOUD' (the seeded id then named a two-author monograph) and set id: null; the id was backfilled to morita2014 on 2026-09-03 (note below) but this rationale and the add-reference action were not updated, so a reader of the row saw an unregistered orphan while references.ts held the entry. The add-reference action is DONE (bean qou-zdty completed); the cite-in-block action stays open (bean qou-hnuw, todo). Verdict unchanged, supporting: Thm 3.1 / Thm 7.1 give the connection formulae of the Ramanujan equation q x u(q^2 x) - u(q x) + u(x) = 0 between 0 and infinity by q-Borel-Laplace resummation, and Thm 8.3 / 9.3 the level r-1 extension for the divergent rphi0 - the explicit q-Stokes precedent the W2 attack needs, registered as the RSZ frame's complement (RSZ covers only integral slopes and gives dimension 0 for a single-slope module). Companion precedent one order down: morita2012b (arXiv:1205.1453, the bilateral 1psi0), triaged 2026-09-07.

keyResults.statement: Connection formula between the local solutions of the Ramanujan q-difference equation qxu(q²x) − u(qx) + u(x) = 0 at the origin and at infinity, valid for x ∈ C* off a q-spiral, obtained by q-Borel–Laplace resummation.
keyResults.useForFolio: A worked, explicit q-Stokes / connection computation on a divergent ₂φ₀(0,0;−;q,x) — the model case for the c₃ W2 bar-odd Stokes extraction.

keyResults.statement: A q-Borel–Laplace transformation of level r−1 yielding an asymptotic formula for the divergent series ᵣφ₀(0,…,0;−;q,x).
keyResults.useForFolio: A higher-level q-Borel kernel to compare against the level parameter in QBorelKernelLevel.lean.
